data.narrative:
Peak Quantum is a pre-seed quantum computing company founded by Leon Koch and team, having raised €5M to date. The quantum computing sector includes eight private peers (notably Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ) and three publicly traded comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS).

Only one valuation method is applicable to this analysis. The Stage-Progression approach uses Peak Quantum's €5M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical 2.5x multiplier for advancement from pre-seed to the subsequent financing stage, yielding an implied valuation of €12M. A peer-median triangulation is not executable; while eight same-sector peers exist, none qualify as sufficiently analogous when filtered by stage, adjacent-stage proximity, or valuation tier, and broadening to all-sector medians would introduce excessive noise.

The triangulated range derived from available methodology is €11M to €14M, with a median of €12M. This reflects the single quantitative anchor available. Key uncertainties limiting confidence include the absence of tight-peer comparable valuations at pre-seed stage in quantum computing and the nascent, heterogeneous nature of the sector itself, which constrains traditional multiples-based approaches. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending either acquisition of nearer-stage peer data or progression to seed-stage when fresh market comparables may emerge.
